description:
Cast Walking Ballista for {X} = 0.
Walking Ballista dies to having zero toughness.
Yedora triggers, returning it to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Tap that Forest for {G}.
Activate Primordial Mist by exiling the face-down Walking Ballista, and allowing you to cast it this turn.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite {G}, you may cast Walking Ballista using an arbitrarily large amount of mana, and then use its second ability to deal an arbitrarily large amount of damage to any target(s).
